workload: modular accumulator of (BIGDIV+i)/D - a big truncated-division stress loop; dividend ~10^53 and divisor ~10^20 are both arbitrary-precision
note: bignum.div is a CORE LOGOS Int operator (Int transparently promotes to BigInt), so main.lg uses it directly - no stdlib import. The >i64 constants are BUILT via arithmetic from i64-safe pieces (LOGOS Int literals cap at i64; bignums come from overflow promotion). Go hand-implements the identical loop with math/big using PREALLOCATED big.Ints and in-place operations (the fast idiomatic form) so any LOGOS win is honest.
